[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 18::Three years.
]


For the price of work done by the plaintiff for the defendant at his request, where no time has been fixed for payment.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the work is done.
